visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a main character, a young man with short black hair wearing a white T-shirt, pointing his right hand toward a Zojirushi branded 'MYBO-02' cup washing and water dispensing machine. The machine is located outdoors on a paved walkway, featuring a wood-grain finish and a transparent lid. Behind the machine, a blue sign with Japanese and English text is visible, along with several passers-by in the distance under bright natural daylight. Yellow and white text overlays are present in the upper half of the frame. (2) The camera zooms in on the machine's digital screen, which displays a green cartoon animation of two cup characters with the text 'Washing is done.' The man's hand reaches out to touch the machine's base. He then lifts the transparent curved lid, revealing a clear plastic cup and a yellow cup lid sitting on a rotating platform inside. He picks up the cup with his left hand, inspecting its interior closely while rotating it in front of the camera. The background shows a slight blur of outdoor greenery and people. (3) The man moves to a different section of the machine or a nearby station featuring a blue and white 'FREE WATER' sign and a vending machine interface. He holds the plastic cup under a water dispenser and presses a button to fill it. After filling, he puts the yellow lid back on the cup. He then takes a sip of the water, looking directly into the lens with a neutral expression before turning to his right to speak with someone off-camera. A second male character, wearing a beige T-shirt and carrying a backpack with a camera, briefly enters the frame, holding a white bottle. The video concludes with a close-up of the main character smiling and laughing towards the camera while holding the cup.
